exemplars.text: Grounding isn't really about the activity itself, it's about the end state. Coming back into your body. Back into the present moment. Back into a sense of safety and sovereignty. So many of us live from the neck up, thinking and thinking because it feels like control. But that's often the very thing that leaves us feeling swirly and untethered. A long shower. Cooking without your phone. Feet on the earth. If it brings you back into yourself, it counts. Full article on Substack. Link in bio.
